summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 23, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items: re-election of Class II directors, re-approval of compensation policy, approval of CEO's compensation package and reappointment as chairman, extension of option terms, and reappointment of auditors. The filing is a standard post-meeting report with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, delisting, or activist campaign. It is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation.
